Sources and method

Evidence and source rights

Metrics come from saved per-attempt request/QA records in the 25 and 27 Oct diagnostic runs. Players use MP3 listening copies transcoded from archived WAV files; all scores were measured on the original WAV outputs. The page includes audio assets and derived summaries only, not raw logs, account details or private storage links. Historical source provenance is recorded in the archived corpus filenames and source hashes; the ten recent source clips were PCM-matched against original LibriSpeech files. No personal recording is included. Source-manifest review flags are not treated as user listening approval.

LibriSpeech: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur, corpus derived from LibriVox audiobooks, CC BY 4.0. CSTR VCTK 0.92: Junichi Yamagishi, Christophe Veaux and Kirsten MacDonald, University of Edinburgh, CC BY 4.0. Outputs are model-edited derivatives; source material has been resampled and edited. Licensing of source recordings is separate from model/dependency commercial-use clearance.
